title: Microsoft 365 Copilot

signIn.hint: Sign in with the demo account first. A new task opens on Chat or Cowork as last chosen (the Chat | Cowork switch under the message box).

nav.note: The sidebar collapses to its icon rail below Copilot's own breakpoint (1024 CSS px, between the 175% and 200% captures); Collapse sidebar does the same at any width (flag). A demo gives the captured variants: { use: 'nav', variant, flagVariant }.

workspace-pane.note: The Workspace pane takes 25% of the room beside the sidebar (its own CSS keeps it 250–400 px); the inline % a capture writes is what it was at that window, so the demo names the captured value.

workspace-chips.note: The Workspace pane's plugin chips: two rows at most, then a "+N" chip; clicking it shows all and it becomes "Show less". A demo gives { use: 'workspace-chips', state, plus: { from: <a capture with the +N chip> } }.

composer-pin.note: The message box is fixed and sits over its placeholder at the bottom of the chat.

split-pane.note: The Workspace and preview panes: a share of the room beside the sidebar, written as flex %.

theme.setting: Settings and more › Settings › Theme (System, Light, Dark)
fallbacks: Images and file thumbnails keep their colors
Charts drawn in an answer (images) keep theirs

writes.what: Sends the prompt: a new task in Recent (or a new turn in the open task)

steps: You: delete the task "{task}" from Recent (its More options › Delete)
undo.note: A private pack can add an API undo that runs in the capture browser's own signed-in session.

check.expect: Recent has no task from the run, other than the ones the demo keeps.

writes.what: The send arrow does what Enter does
Save on the Save skill card creates a skill of her own in Plugins › Added; Copilot names it differently each run

undo.note: Only her own skills (from her OneDrive); a plugin's own skills are never deleted.

writes.what: Approve on a tool card runs that tool's action (it can write wherever the tool writes)
writes.note: The undo depends on the tool: the demo names it (or the plan stops at Approve). Approve on a Copy file card into the skills folder makes a skill: its undo is save-skill's.

check.expect: The demo's own check for that tool.

writes.what: A plugin's switch in Plugins › Added turns it on or off for the next task (wait about 20 s before starting one)

undo.note: Back to the state the demo starts with.

check.expect: Each plugin's switch is as the demo starts.

writes.what: The Chat | Cowork switch under the message box; the choice persists for new tasks

check.expect: A new task opens on the mode the demo starts with (Cowork, for Cowork demos).
Theme reads what the demo starts with.

effects.what: Every prompt in a new task leaves a task in Recent

check.expect: Recent holds only the tasks the demo keeps.

effects.what: Copilot can save a memory from a run (Settings › Personalization › saved memories); Cowork keeps its own memories

steps: You: delete the memories the run saved (the second Manage)

check.expect: No saved memories from the run (Copilot or Cowork).

effects.what: Custom instructions (Personalization) aren't changed by a run, but a reset checks they're the demo's wording

check.expect: The custom instructions match the demo's text exactly.

effects.what: Plugin switches apply to the next task, not the open one; a task started right after switching can still miss a plugin

check.expect: Wait about 20 s after a switch before starting the task that needs it.

notes: Fluent v9 (Griffel atomic classes). Step groups open and close like the product's; their lists come from the real open capture or the run's frames. vendor/: library and measured CSS for menus whose rules load the first time they open (no capture has them). The message box is "Message Copilot" on a new task and "Chat input" in an open one.
